info.title: f2b
info.description:
fail2ban's jails, bans, history, configuration and log, as JSON:API 1.1.

Authenticate with an API token from the interface's Config: `Authorization: Bearer f2b_…`. A read token can take every route whose `x-f2b-scope` is `read`; a write token, every route. Send and accept `application/vnd.api+json`. Writes to a file name the version they were made against in `If-Match`, the file's `ETag`.

epoch.description: Names this run of the engine.

status.description: The HTTP status, as a string.

code.description: The contract; title and detail are for a person and may change.

detail.description: A sentence saying what to do about it.

since.description: When it entered this state, in Unix seconds.

restarts.description: The times it stopped without being asked to.

lastExit.description: How it last stopped, or empty.

failedNow.description: Addresses with failures counted now, under maxRetry.

filter.description: The filter it names, without options.

file.description: The edited file that defines it; null for a jail only fail2ban's own files define.

at.description: When it began, Unix seconds; 0 where the database does not have it yet.

until.description: When it ends; 0 for never or not known.

count.description: Which ban of this address in this jail it is.

matches.description: The log lines that did it.

version.description: A digest of the content; send it back as If-Match.

items.description: Its bracketed sections but DEFAULT and INCLUDES: in a jail file, its jails.

content.description: The whole file; only where one file is asked for.

also.description: Other files the change wrote: the jails a rename changed.

output.description: What fail2ban said; says so when the engine restarted it.

Applied.description: What a write did besides: a failed reload leaves the file saved.

id.description: A digest of what was tried.
A digest of what was tried.

content.description: Only where one file is asked for.

name.description: Its name; for a place logs are read from, its path.

jails.description: The running jails that read it.

source.description: On a place logs are read from only: mount, a read-only mount; jail, where a running jail reads a log.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: The version the change was made against: the file's ETag, or attributes.version.

BadRequest.description: invalid, or body_too_large: the request is not one this takes.

Unauthenticated.description: No token, or one that is unknown, revoked or expired.

Forbidden.description: A read token on a route that changes something.

NotFound.description: No such jail, file or route.

Conflict.description: A file that is already there, or a resource type or id that is not this endpoint's.

PreconditionFailed.description: The file changed since the version in If-Match: read it again.

Unprocessable.description: config_rejected, with fail2ban's words in meta.output; or fail2ban refused a command.

RateLimited.description: Too many refused tokens from this address.
